assets.what: the dog's invisible pose driver: about 170 spheres (torso, neck, skull, muzzle, nose, eyes, ears, tail, four two-bone legs, paws) built in build/lib.py; only their outline is used, as the scissors' path
assets.operation: posed per frame from the score (build/choreo.py); ray-cast for its outline, depth order and piece boundaries only (build/render.py); no shading shown on the dog

assets.what: the person: spheres, built in build/lib.py
assets.operation: constructed and posed

assets.what: porch floor planks, sill, facade planes, door frame, door leaf, lit room
assets.operation: planes ray-cast per pixel; floor planks and clapboard lines synthesized; light pool computed through the door opening

assets.what: voices (formant synthesis), cut grains, footfalls, door creak, breath, room tone
assets.operation: synthesized

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, Literata, JetBrains Mono (tools/paeleo/fonts)
assets.operation: glyph shapes used as cutting templates for the letters; card text
read: positions, act channels, timeline

not_used: the Academy Film Archive Caroline and Frank Mouris Collection (not viewed, not accessible here; no footage, still or title from it used)
